text:
## Overview Process  
```
Customer Requests Address Change
↓
Verify Customer Identity
↓
Identify All Affected Accounts
↓
Collect New Address Details
↓
Verify New Address (Proof of Address)
↓
Update KYC Records
↓
Assess AML Risk (New Address/Country)
↓
AML Screening (if high-risk)
↓
Update All Systems (Core, Standing Orders, Direct Debits, DW)
↓
Update Statement Delivery
↓
Update Communications (Email/Phone/Post)
↓
Notify Customer of Change
↓
Close Change Request
```  
**Timeline:** 2-5 business days (depending on proof of address requirement)

raw_entities.name: Customer Address Change Process
raw_entities.description: An end-to-end operational workflow for updating a customer's address across all bank systems. The process takes between 2-5 business days, depending on whether proof of address is required.
context: Timeline: 2-5 business days (depending on proof of address requirement)

raw_entities.name: Customer Identity Verification
raw_entities.description: The initial step in the address change workflow where the bank verifies the identity of the customer making the request.

raw_entities.name: Affected Account Identification
raw_entities.description: The stage where all bank accounts linked to the customer that are impacted by the address change are identified.

raw_entities.name: New Address Detail Collection
raw_entities.description: The action of gathering the specific details of the customer's new residential or mailing address.

raw_entities.name: New Address Verification
raw_entities.description: The validation of the new address provided by the customer, specifically involving the review of Proof of Address documentation.

raw_entities.name: KYC Record Update
raw_entities.description: The process of updating the customer's Know Your Customer (KYC) files with the newly verified address information.

raw_entities.name: AML Risk Assessment
raw_entities.description: An assessment of Anti-Money Laundering (AML) risk based on the new address or country of residence.

raw_entities.name: High-Risk Address Gate
raw_entities.description: A decision point following the AML risk assessment to determine if the new address is high-risk, which triggers mandatory AML screening.

raw_entities.name: AML Screening Execution
raw_entities.description: The execution of AML screening procedures, performed only if the previous risk assessment identified the address as high-risk.

raw_entities.name: Global System Update
raw_entities.description: The update of the new address across all banking infrastructure, including Core systems, Standing Orders, Direct Debits, and the Data Warehouse (DW).
context: Update All Systems (Core, Standing Orders, Direct Debits, DW)

raw_entities.name: Statement Delivery Update
raw_entities.description: Updating the destination and method for delivering bank statements to the customer's new address.

raw_entities.name: Communications Channel Update
raw_entities.description: Updating the customer's contact communication details, covering email, phone, and postal addresses.

raw_entities.name: Customer Change Notification
raw_entities.description: The final communication sent to the customer confirming that the address change has been successfully processed.

raw_entities.name: Change Request Closure
raw_entities.description: The administrative closure of the change request once all updates and notifications are complete.

raw_entities.name: Bank Customer
raw_entities.description: The individual requesting the address change and providing the necessary proof of address documentation.
